text:
alex: Hey team — I'm oncall this week and running through access checks. Trying to open the runtime runbook but Confluence gives a 403 when I follow the runbooks index link. Anyone know who to ping for runbook perms?

tia: Welcome! :wave: what's the email you used to sign up? Did you accept the PagerDuty invite?

alex: alex@redwood.ai — I think I accepted PD but right now I can't acknowledge alerts (it says insufficient permissions). Confluence 403 is blocking runbook access.

bryce: Likely you weren't added to the escalation policy. @ops-bot can you confirm PD membership/roles for alex@redwood.ai?

ops-bot: ops-bot: Checking PagerDuty... user found (alex@redwood.ai). role=Responder; not in 'runtime-escalation' policy.

tia: If PD role was limited that's why. alex, share the exact Confluence URL you're hitting? Sometimes SSO mapping is funky.

alex: https://confluence.redwood/inference/runbooks/runtime-oncall — page: 'You don't have permission to view this page'.

bryce: I've added alex to runtime-escalation on PD and pushed refresh. alex, try PD again and let us know.

alex: PD is better now — I can acknowledge alerts. Confluence still 403.

tia: Confluence perms are separate (people-ops or infra). @infra-bot can you check runbooks-readers group membership and SSO mapping?

infra-bot: infra-bot: Opened ticket INC-2102 to add alex@redwood.ai to 'runbooks-readers'. Changes applied; cache flush may take ~5 minutes.

alex: Thanks — I can open the runbook now. Quick question: the 'pager play' section references `kubectl -n runtime logs ...` but I don't have kube access. Who grants read-only pod log access for oncall?

tia: For oncall we grant read-only logs for specific namespaces. Tag @eng-oncall-admins in a ticket or ping infra. Also we try to get new oncall folks a shadow session — I can shadow Tuesday 11am if that works.

bryce: I'll mentor you during the first pager(s). Quick onboarding checklist: 1) PD escalation membership 2) Confluence runbook access 3) kube read-only for runtime namespace 4) join #oncall-ops daily stand-in at 09:15.

alex: Awesome, thank you. One more — is there a recorded runthrough or a short checklist video? Couldn't find a recording in docs.

tia: Loom overview here: https://loom.com/share/xyz (oncall orientation). I'll pin the 'oncall-orientation' checklist in #eng-oncall and DM you the link.

bryce: Reminder — for noisy alerts use the 'pd-noise' tag and don't escalate unless SLOs are impacted. The runbook has examples for different alert classes.

alex: Got it, appreciate the quick assist :pray:
